title: Request for Proposal for Consultancy Services to Develop a White Paper on the National Digital Addressing System for Namibia
why: Q2: terms of reference say Namibia lacks a unified standardized addressing system, local-authority practice is fragmented and rural and informal areas lack formal addresses; the system is for future integration with emergency, utility and postal registers.

title: Tenders
why: Q2: lists the consultancy for the National Digital Addressing System white paper as a procurement, so the system was still being developed.

title: Communications Regulatory Authority of Namibia (CRAN)'s Post

title: Street and Place Naming/Renaming Application Form
why: Q2: shows a municipal street naming and property re-numbering process in Windhoek, local rather than national addressing.
